_comment: Curated OriginKit components for Delhi Photo Studio BTH. Install all with `npm run originkit:add` (needs ORIGINKIT_API_KEY in .env.local and network access to originkit.dev). Each was chosen to match the cinematic dark/gold aesthetic and to have zero or light dependencies.

components.name: particle-interlock
components.use: Premium loading-screen orb (counter-rotating Fibonacci dot shells). Drop into Loader.tsx.

components.name: fluidtrail
components.use: GPU Navier-Stokes fluid trail behind the cursor for the hero — upgrades the custom cursor glow.

components.name: satin-flow
components.use: Domain-warped silk shader background for the Studio / Contact bands (subtle, dark-tinted).

components.name: network-lines
components.use: Drifting constellation lines behind the Location / Reviews sections.

components.name: scroll-text-highlight
components.use: Word-by-word scroll highlight for the Studio manifesto copy.

components.name: motion-text-trail
components.use: Cinematic heading trail effect for section titles.

components.name: light-glass-button
components.use: Glassmorphism CTA with cursor-tracked inner light for Book / WhatsApp buttons.

components.name: image-grid
components.use: Alternative animated layout option for the portfolio gallery.
